title: Author per-vertex bind weights for rigid mesh-asset geometry (real RigBinding items)
description:
## Summary
Resolve rigid `GeometryItem`/`RigBindingMetadata` mesh-asset items on real generated geometry to indexed semantic bones and author per-vertex influences once at build time, so the SkinnedMeshRenderer adapter can skin them. This is the production half of TSK-0077 (which proved the contract + LBS on a synthetic 2-segment fixture only).

## Scope
- Consume `GeometryItem.RigBinding`/`SourcePartId` from `GeneratedCreature` real mesh-asset items; resolve `SourcePartId -> SemanticBoneResolver -> SkeletonSnapshot.TryGetIndex` once at bind/setup time (never mesh name, Unity hierarchy order, nearest-bone, or per-frame string lookup).
- Author per-vertex `VertexInfluence[]` (cap and normalize per `LinearBlendSkinning.MaxBoneInfluencesPerVertex` = 4; reuse the existing constant). Rigid single-part items are one dominant influence by construction.
- Resolve mirrored items to the mirrored semantic bone via `SemanticBoneResolver` + `MirrorUtility` reflection; do not rediscover mirror identity (TSK-0054 guardrail) and do not alter `RigBindingMetadata` schema.
- Emit weights as pose-independent pure build-time data on the generation output (not in the renderer adapter) so no second derivation path exists.
- Explicitly EXCLUDE the implicit welded surface (owned by the implicit-weighting task 0131).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every rigid mesh-asset vertex resolves to <=4 valid influences normalized, at the index fixed by the same `SkeletonSnapshot.Capture` ordering the rig and adapter use.
- Mirrored rigid parts resolve to the mirrored semantic identity and reflect correctly.
- Real `GeneratedCreature` fixture binds headlessly (Tests.Runtime) and deforms predictably through the existing `LinearBlendSkinning.Deform` oracle.
- No influence authored on the implicit welded surface under this task.

## Validation
Pure Tests.Runtime (no Unity needed): resolve RigBinding->index once; assert single/mirrored influence indices and cap; assert implicit item emits none. PlayMode confirmation on a real `GeneratedCreature` when Unity is available. dotnet Runtime + Tests.Runtime build and git diff --check.

## Findings
Confirmed (source/HEAD e88ba5d): no live SkinnedMeshRenderer/boneWeights/bindposes anywhere; mesh-asset items carry RigBindingMetadata but no weights; TSK-0077 proved the fixture only. Mesh-asset items are rigid accessory geometry (not the walking welded surface); this task de-risks the full adapter plumbing.

## Blockers
Mirror-identity on mirrored rigid items must reuse SemanticBoneResolver/MirrorUtility; do not re-derive. No Unity-required step to author the data; PlayMode fixture optional.

## Next Step
Implement under TSK-0077 owner as a de-risking enabler in parallel with implicit-surface weighting (0131). Not a prerequisite for 0131.

comments.body:
Implementation and validation evidence (Sprint Round 3): Added Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Animation/Binding/RigidMeshWeightAuthoring.cs as the single pure build-time rigid mesh authoring path. CreatureMeshGenerator captures one SkeletonSnapshot from SkeletonInferrer, resolves each mesh-asset source part through SemanticBoneResolver, uses the existing MirrorUtility placement for mirrored output, and stores cloned VertexInfluence[] payloads on GeometryItem; implicit GeometryType.Implicit items remain empty. RigBindingMetadata schema was unchanged and no per-frame string lookup or preview wiring was added.

Focused Tests.Runtime coverage added in Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/RigidMeshWeightAuthoringTests.cs: ordinary semantic index + implicit exclusion, mirrored semantic index, shared max-influence ceiling/normalization, and real GeneratedCreature mesh-asset deformation through LinearBlendSkinning.Deform. Validation: dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore PASS; dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore PASS; PlayMode focused test job 2f4cbbd900c841cfaaf277ec70998393 PASS (4/4); git diff --check PASS; Unity console error/warning query returned no errors or warnings. EditMode focused job discovered 0 runtime tests, so PlayMode was used as the available runtime discovery path. Residual risk: TSK-0142 preview/SkinnedMeshRenderer consumption of mesh-asset payloads remains intentionally deferred; no full-suite run was required for this focused slice.

comments.body: ROUND 3 review: implemented and spot-checked. RigidMeshWeightAuthoring is a pure build-time path resolving SemanticBoneResolver -> SkeletonSnapshot index, one normalized dominant influence per rigid mesh vertex, with finite-vertex validation and limb misuse rejection. GeneratedCreature stores immutable VertexInfluence arrays; CreatureMeshGenerator authors ordinary/mirrored mesh items once and leaves implicit geometry empty; schema unchanged. Focused tests cover ordinary, mirrored, cap/normalization, implicit exclusion, and LBS deformation. Independent validation: dotnet Runtime build passed, dotnet Tests.Runtime build passed, git diff --check passed. Subagent-reported Unity focused PlayMode 4/4 and clean console. Evidence confidence: source/test spot-check plus independently re-run builds/diff; Unity gate report-trusted. Preview consumption remains TSK-0142.
